patterns.label: AI agent workflow system
patterns.description: Agents, skills, prompts, tools, governance, and handoffs that work together as a repeatable AI workflow.

patterns.label: Evaluation and contract system
patterns.description: Tests, evaluations, schemas, golden cases, and validators that prove behavior and keep agents aligned.

patterns.label: Knowledge graph and retrieval system
patterns.description: Ontology, taxonomy, graph, retrieval, context-pack, and index assets that help agents find and connect the right things.

patterns.label: Governed learning loop system
patterns.description: Lessons, handoffs, asset-use feedback, governance gates, and review loops that improve future agent behavior.

patterns.label: Model, algorithm, or forecasting system
patterns.description: Algorithms, scoring models, forecasters, simulations, optimization models, or frontier math assets paired with tests/data.
positive_signals: model, algorithm, forecast, predict, or optimize language

patterns.label: Security and governance gate system
patterns.description: Policies, hooks, tests, secret handling, prompt-injection defenses, and review gates that let assets scale safely.
positive_signals: pre-push, policy, secret, or prompt-injection language

patterns.label: Asset cluster delta
patterns.description: Near-duplicate or variant assets compared as a cluster with shared core, strengths, neutral differences, and weaker parts.
positive_signals: same need solved in multiple repos

patterns.label: Asset use instance
patterns.description: A specific before-use or after-use record showing how an asset was found, used, upgraded, blocked, or valued.
missing_evidence: curation into score or ceiling calibration

rule: Pattern matches are generated candidate evidence. They guide review, scoring calibration, and composite-asset proposals; they do not prove value or source truth.
